description: Cross-platform game shipping CLI: offline validation + packaging + push to platform test channels. Steam (steamcmd/SteamPipe VDF builds, branch set-live guard) and WeChat mini games (structure/size validation, miniprogram-ci preview QR and dev-version upload). Never publishes to players on its own.

environment.name: SHIP_STEAMCMD
environment.description: Optional explicit path to steamcmd executable (wins over steam.steamcmdPath in ship.config.json; PATH and common install dirs are also searched).

environment.name: SHIP_STEAM_USERNAME
environment.description: Steam build-account username. Required for steam push/preview.

environment.name: SHIP_STEAM_PASSWORD
environment.description: Steam build-account password. Omit to use passwordless login via a cached config.vdf.

environment.name: SHIP_STEAM_TOTP
environment.description: Precomputed Steam Guard code for this 30s window.

environment.name: SHIP_STEAM_TOTP_SECRET
environment.description: Steam Guard shared secret (base64); the TOTP code is generated at run time. Preferred for CI.

environment.name: SHIP_STEAM_CONFIG_VDF
environment.description: base64-encoded steamcmd config/config.vdf carrying a logged-in token; seeded next to steamcmd for passwordless login. Re-entering a password invalidates the old token.

environment.name: SHIP_WX_PRIVATE_KEY
environment.description: Path to the WeChat code-upload private key; wins over wechat.privateKeyPath in ship.config.json.

agent.whenToUse: Shipping a built game to distribution platforms: packaging/upload to Steam (depot builds via steamcmd) or WeChat mini games (dev-version upload via miniprogram-ci), plus offline package validation and environment preflight. NOT for: making content player-visible (Steam default-branch set-live, WeChat review submission/release/gray rollout are always human steps in platform backends), building engine players (produce artifacts first), or account/credential setup beyond pointing at env vars.

globalOptions.description: Directory containing ship.config.json (default: cwd; searched upward).

commands.description: Offline preflight: config loadability, steamcmd presence, credential mode, wechat project dir, upload key, miniprogram-ci resolvability. Makes no network calls.

options.description: Print the full report as JSON.

output.description: JSON report with per-check status (ok/warn/fail); human mode prints a checklist.

exitCodes.0: report produced (individual checks carry their own status)

commands.description: Write a ship.config.json template into the project directory. Refuses to overwrite an existing file unless --force.

output.description: Human path message, or {written, force} with --json.

commands.description: Load, schema-validate and cross-field-validate ship.config.json (depot sources inside contentRoot, buildOutput/contentRoot not nested, etc.). Any failure prints a stable code plus a concrete fix suggestion.

output.description: Section summary; throws with CFG_* code and details on any violation.

commands.description: Print the normalized config (paths resolved, defaults applied where relevant).
Generate app_build_<appId>.vdf + depot_build_<id>.vdf under <buildOutput>/vdf without running steamcmd. Inspect them or hand-run steamcmd yourself.

options.description: Build description recorded on the partner Builds page.
Branch to auto set live after upload; 'default' is rejected (Valve forbids auto set-live on default).
Print generated file paths as JSON.

output.description: Written VDF paths + effective preview/setLive values.

commands.description: Run steamcmd with Preview=1: the full build pipeline (login, chunking, manifest) but NOTHING is uploaded. Produces logs + a file manifest for inspection.

output.description: appId, buildId (from log), log path; verdict from log analysis (steamcmd exit codes are unreliable).

exitCodes.3: steamcmd run failed or outcome unknown (fail-closed)

commands.description: Upload a real depot build via steamcmd. Optionally set it live on a NON-default branch (Valve forbids automatic default-branch set-live; that step stays human in App Admin -> Builds).

options.description: Build description recorded on the Builds page.
Non-default branch to auto set live after upload (e.g. beta, staging). 'default' is rejected.

output.description: appId, buildId, setLive branch, log path, VDF dir.

exitCodes.0: build uploaded (+ optionally set live on non-default branch)
exitCodes.3: steamcmd run failed or outcome unknown

commands.description: Local smoke checks on the built content: steam_appid.txt presence/match (optionally write it), steam_api*.dll presence, configured executable existence, plus run/builds URLs.

options.description: Create steam_appid.txt in contentRoot when missing (idempotent).

output.description: Local file prerequisites including Steam API libraries for Windows/Linux/macOS; missing requirements fail with details.

commands.description: Open a Steamworks partner page in the browser. Only target: builds (App Admin -> Builds, where set-live/rollback are done by humans).

output.description: Opens the default browser; no stdout payload.

commands.description: Offline structure and filtered source estimate checks (not actual compiled package size).

output.description: Report with per-package sizes, limits, errors (WX_* codes) and warnings.

commands.description: Generate a phone-test QR code via miniprogram-ci (no version record is created). miniprogram-ci must be installed in the project.

options.description: New PNG output outside game content; default build/ship-preview/<uuid>/qr.png.
Note shown in the dev-version list.

output.description: Result contains actual absolute qrOut, SDK result and ok; a new PNG outside game content is required.

exitCodes.1: invalid structure, parameters or output path

commands.description: Upload a new dev version via miniprogram-ci after running the same offline validation as wx validate (a failed validation prints the complete report with per-item fix suggestions and blocks the upload). Creates a dev version ONLY: selecting 体验版, submitting for review, release and gray rollout are human steps in the MP backend.

options.description: Upload note / changelog shown in the backend.
miniprogram-ci robot slot 1-30 (separate pipelines use separate robots).

output.description: appid, robot, version and miniprogram-ci result incl. subPackageInfo sizes.

commands.description: Open the WeChat MP backend in the browser. Only target: mp.

output.description: Opens the default browser; no stdout payload.
